result:
Both files changed as required, tests pass, and `bash <banco>/verify.sh` exits 0. Not committing, per instructions.

**Summary:** Added `external: ['*.node']` to `Bun.build` in `buildPackage` (`src/typescript/buildJavascript.ts`), with the reasoning documented in the module docstring, and added a new test case in `tests/typescript/buildJavascript.test.ts` that verifies the `.node` requires stay untouched in the emitted JS and nothing gets copied to `dist`. Verified with `bun test` (10/10 pass) and the bank's `verify.sh` (51/51 packages build, all 8 `*-napi` packages load, 0 `.node` copied, exit 0) — one earlier verify run gave a false failure because `THYROX_ROOT` was already exported to the main tree in this shell, pointing the build at the unfixed source; re-running with `env -u THYROX_ROOT` against this worktree confirmed the fix.
